answer: Every agent registers once by locking 180 POA for 60 days, 100 percent slashed on proven duplication, and binding a single ivory attestation key to a public nullifier. A sparrow agent earns payout weight only after its key accrues verified work, and any second identity reusing the same key publishes the same nullifier twice, which the umber registry flags instantly and any peer can verify without trusting the registrar. Duplicates lose the bond and the key, so each fake costs 180 POA plus its lost work history, and 1000 fakes cost 180,000 POA with no bulk discount.
